Title: A customer search by a known QAL number lists that customer
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx, click Manage Contracts then Search.
Type the QAL number of the row in the QAL Number box.
Step Expected: The box shows the QAL number.
The page reloads with the h1 Search.
A row for the QAL number is listed.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A scheme search by a known name lists that scheme
Step Action: Open http://localhost:1946/home.aspx, click Scheme Administration then Search.
Type the scheme name of the row in the scheme name box.

Step Expected: The page reloads with the h1 Search.
A row for the scheme is listed.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
